name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, spent near the Circuit Paul Ricard. He initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, but quickly found his passion lay in the strategic application of data and race simulations. Prior to joining Mercedes-AMG, he honed his skills at smaller racing teams, where he developed a reputation for creative problem-solving and a keen understanding of race dynamics.

Jean-Pierre thrives under pressure, meticulously analyzing every variable to optimize race strategy. He is known for his calm demeanor and ability to communicate complex information clearly to the team. His approach centers on leveraging data-driven insights while remaining adaptable to unexpected circumstances, always searching for that crucial edge that can make the difference between victory and defeat.

What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his ability to visualize the entire race from start to finish, anticipating potential challenges and opportunities. He is a dedicated team player, always willing to go the extra mile to ensure the team's success, making him a valuable asset to Mercedes-AMG.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a thoughtful expression etched on his face.

quirks: Always carries a lucky Eiffel Tower keychain.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to analyze data while standing at his desk.
